```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(readxl)      # read .xlsx
library(dplyr)       # data wrangling
library(stringr)     # string ops
library(janitor)     # clean names, tabyl
library(lubridate)   # dates/years handling
library(rsample)     # initial_split / rsample API
library(skimr)       # quick data summaries

set.seed(42) # for reproducibility
```

## Import data 

```{r import}
# Adjust path if CSM.xlsx is in a subfolder, e.g., "dataset/CSM.xlsx"
setwd("/Users/hainguyen/University/SecondYear/Sem3/STAT452 Statistics II/Project")

raw <- read_xlsx("dataset/CSM.xlsx") %>%
  janitor::clean_names() # snake_case column names

dim(raw)
head(raw, 3)
skimr::skim(raw)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
